primitives.name: Calibration Loss
primitives.verbatim_quote: log-loss `phi^LL = -Σ Y_k log S_k`, Brier `phi^BS = Σ (S_k - Y_k)2`
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'Y_k': 'true outcome (binary indicator)', 'S_k': 'predicted probability (scalar in [0,1])', 'phi^LL': 'log-loss scalar', 'phi^BS': 'Brier score scalar'}
primitives.assumptions: Predictions are probabilistic; outcomes are binary; loss functions are convex.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When predictions approach 0 or 1, or when true outcomes are rare.

layer2.mapping: GSI’s calibration engine maps these losses onto posterior uncertainty bounds for ensemble forecasting.
layer2.telemetry: Confidence interval width for predicted outcomes

primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'R_adj': 'adjusted rank (dimensionless)', 'Own-Diff': 'difference in ownership percentage from mean', 'Leverage': 'relative impact of player selection on lineup variance'}
primitives.assumptions: Ownership distribution is known; leverage is inversely proportional to variance.
